items.title: Articulate3D / USDNet scene-to-part prediction
items.caption: Start at the scene point cloud and follow the branches to movable parts, interaction regions, and motion parameters. Each output answers a different question about how the scene can be used.

zh.title: Articulate3D / USDNet：从场景到部件的预测
zh.caption: USDNet 以场景点云为输入，分别预测可动部件、交互区域和运动参数。图中不同分支对应这些预测任务。

items.title: Articulate3D articulation annotations
items.caption: Watch the part-level annotation move with the scene. The example helps separate a visible boundary from a representation that also states how a part can move.
items.credit: Halacheva et al., Articulate3D (ICCV 2025); preview uses an official project figure

zh.title: Articulate3D 关节标注示例
zh.caption: 视频演示了带有关节标注的场景：哪些部件能够移动，以及它们沿什么方向平移或旋转。
zh.credit: Halacheva 等，Articulate3D（ICCV 2025）；预览使用官方项目图

items.title: ConceptGraphs: objects, language, and spatial relations
items.caption: The scene is built up as an object graph. Watch how language queries refer to objects and their relations, giving a planner a way to ask about the mapped environment.

zh.title: ConceptGraphs：物体、语言与空间关系
zh.caption: 视频展示了如何将观测整理成包含物体及其关系的场景图，再用语言查询图中的目标，辅助机器人规划。

items.title: Open3DIS: combining 2D masks with 3D proposals
items.caption: Read the diagram from left to right: masks from individual views are lifted through superpoints, merged into 3D proposals, then matched with text through pointwise features.

zh.title: Open3DIS：结合 2D mask 与三维候选区域
zh.caption: 流程从左到右：借助超点将不同视角的 2D mask 映射到三维，合并得到候选区域，再通过逐点特征与文本匹配。

items.title: Segment–Snap: linking parts and handles
items.caption: A handle provides a clue to a door’s hinge side; the surrounding part helps interpret the handle. The video shows how these two cues refine motion and interaction-region predictions from a scene point cloud.
items.credit: Kong and Yang, Segment–Snap (2026); local poster extracted from the official overview at approximately 18 s

zh.title: Segment–Snap：连接部件与把手
zh.caption: 把手位置为门的铰链侧提供线索，周围部件则帮助判断把手类别。视频展示了如何利用这两类线索，改进场景点云中的运动和交互区域预测。
zh.credit: Kong 与 Yang，Segment–Snap（2026）；预览图取自官方视频约第 18 秒

items.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting novel-view rendering
items.caption: This official scene fly-through illustrates what Gaussian splats optimize for: fast, view-dependent rendering from an explicit collection of anisotropic primitives.
items.credit: Kerbl et al., 3D Gaussian Splatting (SIGGRAPH 2023); preview uses an official project figure

zh.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting：新视角渲染
zh.caption: 这段场景漫游展示了 3D Gaussian Splatting 的新视角渲染效果。场景由一组 Gaussian primitives 表示，可以在相机移动时快速生成画面。
zh.credit: Kerbl 等，3D Gaussian Splatting（SIGGRAPH 2023）；预览使用官方项目图

items.title: SplaTAM online RGB-D reconstruction
items.caption: Watch the map accumulate while the camera moves. The video connects online pose estimation, Gaussian map expansion, and the reconstruction that becomes available during a scan.

zh.title: SplaTAM：在线 RGB-D 重建
zh.caption: 随着相机移动，SplaTAM 一边估计相机位姿，一边更新 Gaussian map。视频展示了扫描过程中重建结果的变化。

items.title: URDFormer: from an image to an articulated scene
items.caption: Follow the prediction from a single image to a structured scene description. The useful output here is the set of objects, parts, and joints that can be assembled in a simulator.
items.credit: Chen et al., URDFormer (RSS 2024); local poster derived from the official project video at approximately 90 s

zh.title: URDFormer：从图像到关节场景
zh.caption: URDFormer 从图像中预测物体、部件及其关节关系，再将它们组装成模拟器中的场景。
zh.credit: Chen 等，URDFormer（RSS 2024）；预览图取自官方视频约第 90 秒

items.title: SceneDreamer: an unbounded generated landscape
items.caption: SceneDreamer extends a landscape beyond a single view. The figure shows the terrain and appearance that must remain consistent as the camera moves through the generated world.
items.credit: Chen et al., SceneDreamer (TPAMI 2023), official project figure
items.license_label: Official project figure; rights not stated

zh.title: SceneDreamer：可无限扩展的生成式景观
zh.caption: SceneDreamer 生成大范围的三维景观。与生成单张风景图不同，相机移动后，同一片地形仍需保持形状和外观的一致。
zh.license_label: 官方项目图；未声明权利许可

items.title: Holodeck: building a room from a description
items.caption: The pipeline turns a text request into a room layout, selects assets, and places them under spatial constraints. These intermediate decisions explain how the generated room becomes an environment an agent can enter.
items.credit: Yang et al., Holodeck (CVPR 2024); local poster derived from the official project video at approximately 23 s

zh.title: Holodeck：根据描述构建房间
zh.caption: Holodeck 根据文本描述生成房间布局，选择物体资产，再按空间约束摆放物体，得到可用于智能体仿真的室内场景。
zh.credit: Yang 等，Holodeck（CVPR 2024）；预览图取自官方视频约第 23 秒

items.title: Infinigen Indoors procedural interior
items.caption: The room is assembled from procedural objects and layout rules. Its geometry and scene structure are available along with the rendered image, which makes it useful for generating training annotations.
items.credit: Raistrick et al., Infinigen Indoors (CVPR 2024), official project image
items.license_label: Official project image; rights not stated

zh.title: Infinigen Indoors 的程序化室内场景
zh.caption: 这个房间由程序化物体和布局规则构建而成。除了渲染图像，还能获得几何和场景结构，因此也可用于生成训练标注。
zh.credit: Raistrick 等，Infinigen Indoors（CVPR 2024），官方项目图
zh.license_label: 官方项目图；未声明权利许可

items.title: VoxPoser: language programs to 3D value maps
items.caption: The pipeline separates language-derived affordances and constraints from the motion planner: 3D value maps turn a textual instruction into spatial objectives the robot can re-evaluate during execution.
items.credit: Huang et al., VoxPoser (CoRL 2023), official project figure
items.license_label: Official project figure; rights not stated

zh.title: VoxPoser：从语言程序到三维价值图
zh.caption: VoxPoser 根据语言指令和视觉观测构建三维价值图，用它描述目标位置、可接触区域及约束，再交给运动规划器生成轨迹。执行过程中可以根据新观测更新价值图。
zh.license_label: 官方项目图；未声明权利许可

items.title: OpenVLA recovery rollout in clutter
items.caption: Watch what happens after an unsuccessful grasp. The robot repositions and tries again to place the eggplant in the pot, with other objects still on the table.
items.credit: Kim et al., OpenVLA (2024), official project video; preview uses an official project figure
items.license_label: Official project video; rights not stated

zh.title: OpenVLA：抓取失败后的再次尝试
zh.caption: 第一次抓取失败后，机器人调整位置，再次尝试将茄子放入锅中。这个片段展示了策略如何根据新的观测继续执行任务。
zh.credit: Kim 等，OpenVLA（2024），官方项目视频；预览使用官方项目图
zh.license_label: 官方项目视频；未声明权利许可

items.title: RoboCasa: opening a door
items.caption: The robot must reach the handle, maintain contact, and follow the door’s motion. This short example shows what a scene representation eventually has to support during execution.
items.credit: Nasiriany et al., RoboCasa; local poster derived from the official door-opening video at approximately 3 s

zh.title: RoboCasa：打开柜门
zh.caption: 机器人先靠近并抓住把手，再随着柜门转动调整手臂轨迹。完成这个动作既需要找到把手，也需要在开门过程中维持接触。
zh.credit: Nasiriany 等，RoboCasa；预览图取自官方视频约第 3 秒

items.title: ScanNet++ multi-sensor scene capture
items.caption: Laser scans, DSLR images, and mobile RGB-D sequences capture the same rooms at different levels of detail. The chosen input matters when comparing reconstruction or segmentation methods.

zh.title: ScanNet++ 多传感器场景采集
zh.caption: 激光扫描、DSLR 图像和移动 RGB-D 序列以不同精细程度记录同一个房间。比较重建或分割方法时，需要注意它们使用了哪种输入。
zh.license_label: ScanNet++ 使用条款（项目网站）

items.title: SceneFun3D: from a task to a functional region
items.caption: A request such as opening a drawer needs a smaller, more specific target than the whole cabinet. SceneFun3D annotates these functional regions alongside language descriptions and motion information.

zh.title: SceneFun3D：从任务到功能区域
zh.caption: 要打开抽屉，目标区域需要比整个柜子更小、更具体。SceneFun3D 为这些功能区域提供语言描述和运动标注。

items.title: UMPNet open-ended exploration
items.caption: Arrows encode candidate directions and the predicted change of state. Read it as an example of action serving two roles at once: moving an object and revealing which motion hypothesis is useful.
items.credit: Xu, He, and Song, UMPNet (RA-L / ICRA 2022)

zh.title: UMPNet 的开放式探索
zh.caption: 图中的箭头表示候选动作方向及预测的状态变化。机器人通过尝试这些动作，观察物体能够怎样运动。

items.title: UMPNet articulation structure inferred from action
items.caption: The inferred axes summarize what the exploratory actions reveal about the object’s joints. Interaction supplies information that is difficult to recover from a single static view.
items.credit: Xu, He, and Song, UMPNet (RA-L / ICRA 2022)

zh.title: UMPNet：由动作推断关节结构
zh.caption: 机器人根据探索过程中观察到的部件运动估计关节轴。这类运动信息很难从一张静态图像中直接获得。
